fields.subject: Core Log Events
fields.trigger: code elsewhere in the library calls RetryingDbConnection, CiruitBreakingDbConnection, CiruitBreakingDbCommand, CiruitBrokenDbConnectionTest, CiruitBrokenDbCommandTest, CiruitBrokenDbConnectionRestored, or CiruitBrokenDbCommandRestored on the logger
fields.response: log the call via the corresponding wrapper: RetryingDbConnection (Warning, event id ConnectRetry), CiruitBreakingDbConnection/CiruitBreakingDbCommand (Critical, event id CircuitBreaker), CiruitBrokenDbConnectionTest/CiruitBrokenDbCommandTest (Information, event id CircuitBreaker), or CiruitBrokenDbConnectionRestored/CiruitBrokenDbCommandRestored (Information, event id CircuitBreaker), naming the connection or command and, for a retry, the attempt number
